theme.name: Plate Studio
theme.tagline: Pick ingredients that fit the order and plate them beautifully.
brief.autumn_comfort.title: Autumn comfort
brief.autumn_comfort.desc: A guest wants a warming vegetarian plate for a rainy October evening. Seasonal, no rush (max. 60 min), with at least one flavour pair.
brief.spring_light.title: Light spring lunch
brief.spring_light.desc: Something fresh and green for the first warm day. Seasonal spring produce, ready in 30 minutes.
brief.summer_vegan.title: Vegan summer plate
brief.summer_vegan.desc: A plant-based plate for a hot afternoon on the terrace. No animal products, 30 minutes max.
brief.winter_feast.title: Winter feast
brief.winter_feast.desc: A festive winter dinner. Take your time (max. 75 min), but show two flavour pairs on one plate.
brief.quick_lunch.title: Quick desk lunch
brief.quick_lunch.desc: Vegetarian, tasty and on the table in 20 minutes – the season doesn't matter.
brief.date_night.title: Date night
brief.date_night.desc: An autumn dinner for two. Two flavour pairs to impress, ready within an hour.
brief.garden_party.title: Garden party
brief.garden_party.desc: Vegetarian summer plates for a garden party. Quick to plate: 25 minutes.
brief.coastal_spring.title: Coastal spring
brief.coastal_spring.desc: A spring menu by the sea. Fish is welcome, meat is not. 40 minutes max.
brief.cozy_vegan_winter.title: Cozy vegan winter
brief.cozy_vegan_winter.desc: A hearty plant-based plate for a snowy evening. Winter produce, max. 60 minutes.
brief.student_budget.title: Fifteen-minute vegan
brief.student_budget.desc: Fully plant-based and done in 15 minutes – with one flavour pair that makes it special.
brief.partner_showcase.title: Partner summer challenge
brief.partner_showcase.desc: A demo challenge from a fictional partner: a summer plate in 30 minutes.
rule.season.ok: Partly seasonal: {count} of {total} components fit {tag} (all-year staples count half).
rule.season.bad: Off season: only {count} of {total} components fit {tag}.
rule.vegetarian.good: Fully vegetarian – the brief is met.
rule.vegetarian.bad: Not vegetarian: {part} contains meat or fish.
rule.vegan.good: Fully plant-based – the brief is met.
rule.vegan.bad: Not vegan: {part} is an animal product.
rule.pescatarian.good: No meat – fits the pescatarian brief.
rule.pescatarian.bad: {part} is meat, which this brief rules out.
rule.time.good: Ready in {total} min – within the {max}-minute budget.
rule.pairs.ok: Only {count} of {min} flavour pairs (e.g. {a} + {b}) – add another contrast.
rule.pairs.bad: No flavour pair yet – try e.g. citrus + herbs or sweet + spicy.
